title: Montreal Smoked Meat Sandwich
description: Montreal Smoked Meat Sandwich is a dish from Canada prepared with corned beef, rye bread, fermented cucumber, yellow mustard. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Corned beef replaces traditionally cured AND smoked Montréal brisket; this is a sandwich-inspired adaptation, not authentic smoked meat.

steps.instruction: Poach the listed ingredients in barely simmering liquid for about 25 minutes until tender and cooked through.
Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
